title: F47 · where_is_god · "Where Is God?"
lines: Dadi. Where does God actually live?
On Kailash. Where is Kailash? Far. How far?
Can we go? Nobody has ever climbed it.
"Can we go?" "Nobody has ever climbed it."
Then how does anybody meet him?
Sit like me. Close your eyes. Now be very, very still.
"Sit like me. Close your eyes. Now be very, very still."
In the window behind them, their two reflections looked exactly like two small mountains.
Do you feel that quiet place inside?
"Do you feel that quiet place inside?"
He is not far. You were just moving too much to notice. That is sadhana.
